hook: A 194-page section of FBI case file 62-HQ-83894 covering UFO/flying disc investigations from 1947–1968, for which pymupdf text extraction yielded no readable content — the document pages are almost certainly scanned images with no embedded text layer, rendering the full file contents unanalyzable from this extraction alone.
why_it_matters: This section of the 62-HQ-83894 file is significant because the official description indicates it contains newly declassified pages beyond what the FBI Vault previously released, including eyewitness testimonies, photographic evidence from Oak Ridge (a nuclear facility), and technical propulsion proposals. However, because text extraction returned only blank pages, the actual analytical content remains opaque until OCR is applied to the underlying scans. The single recoverable text element — a declassification authority stamp — confirms the file was processed under NND 90986, a National Archives declassification project.

key_findings.finding: The document was declassified under National Archives declassification authority NND 90986, confirming it underwent formal review before release.

Text extraction via pymupdf returned no readable content across all 194 pages, indicating the document consists entirely of scanned image pages without an embedded text layer — the file is inaccessible to automated text analysis without OCR processing.

The document carries 1 page flagged as containing redaction markers per the metadata, suggesting at least one page has visible redaction blocks even in this more complete release compared to the FBI Vault version.

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: The case file spans 1947–1968, directly overlapping with Project Blue Book's operational period, and FBI HQ files routinely cross-referenced Air Force UFO investigation records during this era.

The official description explicitly references photographic evidence collected at Oak Ridge, TN — a DOE/AEC nuclear site — placing this file in direct connection with nuclear-facility UAP surveillance.
Oak Ridge, TN was an AEC facility, and FBI monitoring of UAP near nuclear installations in this period was conducted partly at AEC's request for security purposes.
FBI HQ UFO files from this period occasionally referenced Air Materiel Command and Wright-Patterson as the military repository for physical evidence and case coordination.
